name: Soil Engineering Laboratory
description: Laboratory tests: sample preparation (sand, clay); consolidation test; direct shear test; vane shear test; unconfined compression test; unconsolidated undrained triaxial test; consolidated drained triaxial test; consolidated undrained triaxial test with pore water pressure measurement; free swell index test; swelling pressure test. Field investigations: borehole drilling; standard penetration test (SPT); electrical resistivity test.
